solutions.title: Expanded bag
solutions.strategy: Materialize each index weight times and choose a random slot.

timeComplexity.explanation: Construction expands total weight W; each pick is O(1).

spaceComplexity.explanation: The bag stores one entry per unit of weight.

solutions.title: Prefix binary search
solutions.strategy: Store cumulative weights and binary-search the sampled point.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each pick performs one binary search over n prefixes.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Prefix sums store one value per index.
